question: In February 2025, the Indian government announced a six-year program to boost the production of which agricultural commodity to reduce import dependence?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pulses**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **February 2025**, the Indian government announced a six-year program to boost the production of **pulses**. This initiative was introduced to reduce India's reliance on imports for this essential commodity.
 
• **Pulses** are an important source of **plant-based protein** and play a vital role in the Indian diet, especially for vegetarians.
 
• India is the world's largest producer, consumer, and importer of pulses, but domestic production has often fallen short of demand, leading to significant imports.</li
